falsification_conditions: A source absent from the explicit request appears in the capsule.
A request exceeding max_sources or max_bytes is admitted.
A declared critical source can be omitted or marked optional.
A source whose bytes differ from its declared SHA-256 is admitted.
Equivalent frozen inputs produce different manifest or capsule bytes.
The committed mechanism and fixture cannot recur from a clean remote clone.

observations.evidence: The sanitized root contains three files; the valid request selected two, and only those two plus the manifest appeared.
The 120-byte fixture was rejected at 121 observed bytes; a two-source request with max_sources=1 was also rejected.
omitted-critical-source.json was rejected with MISSING_CRITICAL_SOURCE; critical-set mismatch tests also passed.
A mutated content pin was rejected with SOURCE_HASH_MISMATCH before output publication.
Repeated builds and order-varied equivalent requests produced byte-identical manifests and files.
Fresh remote clone 8914a4bb2ebe51324e4a8dabd9d36cabe890b4d9 passed 29 focused tests and deterministic recurrence.

scope_boundary: Support is bounded to caller-declared task relevance. The mechanism validates declared relevance tags and exact bytes; it does not independently infer semantic relevance.
statement: Hash-bounded source capsules can admit only task-relevant files while retaining sufficient evidence for recurrence.
